search.query: Perplexity API pricing, Search API, or API changelog update

results.summary: Perplexity updated their Agent API to include Fast Search as the default for certain presets, resulting in a price reduction for web search, and added support for the GPT-6.1-Sol model.
results.title: Agent API Pricing Reduction and Model Update

results.summary: The Perplexity API pricing example has been updated, resulting in a lower total cost and the inclusion of a new web search pricing line item.
results.title: Perplexity API Pricing Update

output.content:
Agent API Pricing Reduction and Model Update: Agent API presets (low, medium, high) now use Fast Search by default. Web search pricing dropped from $2.50 to $1.00 per 1,000 invocations. Added support for openai/gpt-6.1-sol model.
Perplexity API Pricing Update: The total calculated cost for the sample request has decreased from $0.007 to $0.0055. A new row for `web_search` (Fast Search) priced at $0.001 has been added to the pricing table.
